## Où j'en suis
Staging analytics RDS has been successfully upgraded to PostgreSQL 17.2 via blue/green deployment. The initial apply failed due to missing logical replication settings, fixed by updating the Terraform module and performing a controlled instance reboot. pg_partman upgraded to 5.x and maintenance passed. DBT models run cleanly on the new engine. Production migration is paused pending a full week of stable staging and formal sign-off; the runbook has been updated to reflect the required pre-flight steps. (source: s3-06, s3-09, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] Continuous monitoring of staging stability on PG 17.2 during the mandatory one-week validation period (source: src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Define a production cutover slot outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock once staging clears, executing the prerequisite `rds.logical_replication = 1` parameter change and reboot before creating the blue/green deployment (source: s1-05, s3-09)
- [essai-raté] Blue/green creation failed initially with `InvalidParameterCombination` because the source parameter group lacked logical replication; resolved by setting the static parameter, applying a pending-reboot, and reapplying (source: s3-04, s3-06)
- [question] Confirmed production timeframe remains strictly dependent on Maya's sign-off following the staging observation week (source: src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] AWS Terraform provider version locked to 5.82 to prevent v6 breaking changes from entering the PR (source: s1-02)
